Name: DEPRECATED- Prismatic Skirts and Dresses
Author: SurfingMimikyu
Description:
[u][b][size=5]THIS MOD IS NO LONGER MAINTAINED, FOR 1.6 PLAYERS I WOULD RECOMMEND [/size][size=5][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24796]WEAR THE RAINBOW[/url] MOD INSTEAD[/size][/b]

Adds 4 new items:[/u]
[list]
[*]Prismatic Skirt
[*]Prismatic Pleated Skirt
[*]Prismatic Long Dress
[*]Prismatic Simple Dress
[/list][u]Each of these can be obtained from the tailoring recipe:[/u]
[list]
[*]Cloth + Prismatic Shard
[/list][u]Install:[/u]
[list]
[*]Requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 3.0[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Copy the entire "[CP] Prismatic Skirts" folder into "Stardew Valley\Mods"
[/list]

It's a fairly simple mod but I was always shocked as to why skirts didn't have any prismatic variants so I decided to add them myself. Currently, the only way to obtain them is through tailoring. However, if you would like even more prismatic goodness with additional clothes and another way to obtain them I recommend checking out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9019]Prismatic Pride[/url] by kdau.

Manifest.Description: Adds a new prismatic counterpart for each skirt type.
